business.name: Cedar Ridge Tax & Bookkeeping
business.tagline: Tax preparation · Bookkeeping · Small business support
business.description: a small tax and bookkeeping office in the Nashville, Tennessee area

wording.formIntro: Our virtual assistant (an AI) replies on this page, usually in under 10 seconds, finds open times from the demo calendar and books your appointment.
wording.formPlaceholder: Example: I need my personal taxes prepared and I have a W-2 and a mortgage.
wording.priceNote: confirmed after we see your documents
wording.noQuote: We will give you a fixed quote after a short intro conversation.
wording.bookedAfter: Please bring your documents if you have them. Reply here if anything changes.
wording.askService: what do you need help with (for example a tax return, bookkeeping, payroll or starting a business)?

hours.text: Mon-Thu 9 AM-5 PM, Fri 9 AM-4 PM, Central Time

facts.parking: There is free parking behind the office, and the back entrance is step-free.
facts.walkIns: We meet by appointment so that your preparer has your file ready. I can look for the earliest opening.
facts.duration: An intro conversation usually takes about 30 to 45 minutes.

urgency.label: Time-sensitive notice
urgency.safetyNote: Please keep the notice or letter handy so we can look at it together.
urgency.handoffReason: Time-sensitive tax notice or deadline (IRS letter, levy, audit or filing due now): priority callback, a person must call this client now.

alwaysHuman.label: tax or legal advice questions
alwaysHuman.reply: Questions about what you owe, whether you should file, or what is legal need a tax professional who has your details, so I have passed this to a teammate who will follow up with you directly.

alwaysHuman.label: engagement letters, contracts or fee disputes
